title: Final Exam Time Conflict — Contact Your College Advising Unit
description: If two of your final exams appear at the same time, compare the exact course codes, sections, dates, and times in the official schedule, then contact your College Advising Unit immediately with both entries and ask for written instructions. Do not skip an exam or assume a replacement time is approved. UAEU's Fall 2026–2027 exam key explicitly grants students with three exams on one day the right to change one exam by contacting advising in advance; it does not state that the same-day overload rule automatically grants a change for exactly two exams that overlap.
audience: UAEU students checking final exams for Fall 2026–2027
keywords: two final exams are scheduled at the same time
two final exams at the same time
final exams scheduled at the same time
two exams overlap on the final exam schedule
what do i do if final exams overlap

steps.title: Verify the exact schedule entries
steps.instruction: Check each course code, section, date, and time in the official Fall 2026–2027 final-exam key and your registered-student schedule. The public key notes that postgraduate courses and practical laboratories are scheduled by the colleges.

steps.title: Contact your College Advising Unit immediately
steps.instruction: Send both exact schedule entries and ask the unit to investigate the overlap and provide written instructions. The published key does not establish an automatic rescheduling right for exactly two exams at the same time. Do not choose an exam to miss or change either appointment yourself.

steps.title: Keep the three-exam rule separate
steps.instruction: The Fall 2026–2027 key says a student with three examinations on the same day has the right to change the date or time of one by contacting the advising unit in advance. That explicit rule is for three exams on one day; it does not itself resolve a two-exam time collision. For another term, check that term's official exam key.
